{%- let not_configured = "# -- not configured --" -%}

# Code generated by hview. DO NOT EDIT.

{{ section }}
# Hook configuration for hview.
#

{% if hook == InitHook::None -%}
{{ not_configured }}

{%- else -%}
# Initialize hook to add new entries to the database.
export-env {
{%- if hook == InitHook::Prompt %}
  $env.config = (
    $env.config?
    | default {}
    | upsert hooks { default {} }
    | upsert hooks.pre_prompt { default [] }
  )
  let __hview_hooked = (
    $env.config.hooks.pre_prompt | any { try { get __hview_hook } catch { false } }
  )
  if not $__hview_hooked {
    $env.config.hooks.pre_prompt = ($env.config.hooks.pre_prompt | append {
      __hview_hook: true,
      code: {|| ^hview add -- $env.PWD}
    })
  }
{%- else if hook == InitHook::Pwd %}
  $env.config = (
    $env.config?
    | default {}
    | upsert hooks { default {} }
    | upsert hooks.env_change { default {} }
    | upsert hooks.env_change.PWD { default [] }
  )
  let __hview_hooked = (
    $env.config.hooks.env_change.PWD | any { try { get __hview_hook } catch { false } }
  )
  if not $__hview_hooked {
    $env.config.hooks.env_change.PWD = ($env.config.hooks.env_change.PWD | append {
      __hview_hook: true,
      code: {|_, dir| ^hview add -- $dir}
    })
  }
{%- endif %}
}

{%- endif %}

{{ section }}
# When using hview with --no-cmd, alias these internal functions as desired.
#

# Jump to a directory using only keywords.
export def --env --wrapped __hview_h [...rest: directory] {
  match $rest {
    [] => { ls . },
    [ '-' ] => { ls - },
    [ $arg ] if (try { ls $arg; true } catch { false }) => {
      ^hview add -- $arg
    },
    _ => {
      ls (^hview query --exclude $env.PWD -- ...$rest | str trim -r -c "\n")
    }
  }
{%- if echo %}
  echo $env.PWD
{%- endif %}
}

# Jump to a directory using interactive search.
export def --env --wrapped __hview_hi [...rest: string] {
  ls $'(^hview query --interactive -- ...$rest | str trim -r -c "\n")'
{%- if echo %}
  echo $env.PWD
{%- endif %}
}

{{ section }}
# Commands for hview. Disable these using --no-cmd.
#

{%- match cmd %}
{%- when Some with (cmd) %}

export alias {{cmd}} = __hview_h
export alias {{cmd}}i = __hview_hi

{%- when None %}

{{ not_configured }}

{%- endmatch %}

{{ section }}
# Add this to your env file (find it by running `$nu.env-path` in Nushell):
#
#   hview init nushell | save -f ~/.hview.nu
#
# Now, add this to the end of your config file (find it by running
# `$nu.config-path` in Nushell):
#
#   source ~/.hview.nu
#
# Note: hview only supports Nushell v0.106.0+.
